terra.problem: It restricts the neighbor to the person living closest. The psalm does not define neighbor that narrowly.
It says the neighbor is whoever lives right next door. The psalm does not give that definition.
Nobody gets honor for a big bank account goes beyond the verse, which says whom the person honors but does not rule out every other basis for honor.
That's the whole list implies the verse excludes everyone else from being honored. It does not say that.
The dough story does not show any cost to keeping the promise, so the comparison misses the action in the verse.
It treats lending without interest as ruling out every kind of fee or extra charge. The verse specifically says without interest.
The verse says the person refuses the bribe, not that he never thinks it over first.
